# AI Instructions for FuseCP

This file exists only for tools that look specifically for `.github/copilot-instructions.md`.

The single source of truth for AI coding guidance in this repository is [`AGENTS.md`](../../AGENTS.md) at the repository root. Read and follow it, together with:

- `CONTRIBUTING.md` — development, testing, and PR workflow
- `SECURITY.md` — security policy
- `.github/AI_DIRECTIVES.md` — minimum standards for AI-assisted work
- `.github/AI_FUSECP_PLAYBOOK.md` — safe starting workflow
- `.github/AI_CLEANUP_DIRECTIVE.md` — feature/provider removal checklist

Do not duplicate instruction content in this file; keep it as a pointer and maintain the canonical guidance in `AGENTS.md`.
